title: P0 deploy parked mode — explicit mode contract and scheduler policy

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Implementation commit containing the shared exact validator, strict environment value preservation, scheduler outcomes, deploy/canary/production propagation, post-start equality assertions, required test wiring, and mutation coverage.

verifier.independence_note: Executor-produced mechanical evidence; this is not exact-head independent review, PM approval, deployment authorization, or production certification.

does_not_claim: No GitHub secret was created or changed.
No canary or production deployment was performed.
No API restart or production scheduler was started.
No deployed-SHA, service-health, producer-containment, or GREEN readiness claim is made.
No public distribution target was activated.
No merge authorization or T1 PM verdict is claimed.

runtime_proof.environment: local policy execution plus live Supabase smoke; no API process or deployment

policy_execution.command: npx tsx -e <run all scheduler ids through createSchedulerRegistrationPolicy for false and true>

queries.test: database repository bundle persists a submission and settlement when Supabase is configured
invalid atomic enqueue writes no lifecycle event or outbox row
invalid atomic delivery confirmation rolls back outbox status, receipt, lifecycle, and audit writes
invalid atomic settlement writes no settlement, lifecycle event, or audit row
no duplicate participants for the same external_id and sport
re-settling a settled pick creates a correction without a duplicate base row
correction chain is additive and the original settlement row is not mutated

row_counts.note: This lane changes no DB or repository code; the required shared seven-case live smoke suite passed.

credential_transport.command: source main-checkout/local.env into the verification process; explicitly export SYSTEM_PICK_SCANNER_ENABLED=false and SYNDICATE_MACHINE_ENABLED=false

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Use one shared validator: true to active, false to parked, and any undeclared or invalid value fails closed.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Canonical config parser tests plus executable deploy secret-validation tests.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Canary and production preserve the same validated value and post-start checks compare runtime to the requested mode.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Workflow audit verifies one secret consumer, canonical job-output propagation, stage mapping, equality checks, and drift mutations.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Runtime and deploy receipts report actual mode without a hardcoded active claim.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Deploy receipt mutation test and API receipt emitted after actual registration outcomes.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Parked mode suppresses all six provider-derived producer schedulers while active mode preserves eligibility.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Policy unit tests, runtime policy receipts, classification audit, and gate-removal mutations.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: All safety tests execute through the canonical pnpm test and pnpm verify paths and removal is detected.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: package.json wiring plus three negative wiring mutations; full pnpm verify passes.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Existing deploy, rollback, workflow-hardening, static verification, and DB smoke remain green.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: 73 existing deploy regression tests, full pnpm verify, and live DB smoke 7/7 pass.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Done additionally requires secret=false, parked deployment, deployed-SHA proof, expected service health, producer observation, and truthful readiness.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: No secret creation, deployment, restart, production mutation, or readiness certification was performed by this lane.

known_limitations: Direct policy execution proves scheduler registration semantics without starting the API because startup would activate unrelated parked-enabled DB schedulers.
Implementation readiness is not production readiness.
Independent exact-head review, PM approval, secret creation, deployment, and deployed-SHA evidence remain outstanding.
